requirements: Is there exactly one image showing a 4x4 grid of 16 items with no borders, labels or numbers?
Are there precisely 16 distinct objects, one centered in each grid cell?
Does each object fill about 70% of its cell with at least 12% empty margin on all sides?
Do no objects touch or cross any cell edges or overlap with each other?
Is the first item in the top-left cell a single flat pressed old book page that is cream-colored with faint brown edges?
Is the second item a thick green hardcover novel with a plain gold stripe on the spine, standing slightly open?
Is the third item a pair of round reading glasses with thin gold frames?
Is the fourth item a folded red pop-up card open to show a small paper dragon popping out?
Is the fifth item a shiny gold rounded-rectangle library card with a signature scribble and a little sparkle?
Is the sixth item a purple knit sweater laid flat with a small cream finger-to-lips icon on the chest?
